description: 1. Run fetch_price.py with the correct symbol mappings: BTC→btc.v and GOLD→xauusd (not the raw ticker names). Retrieve prices: BTC ~$67432, GOLD ~$2341. 2. Recognize this is 'comparison mode' per Step 2 of the skill, requiring both assets to be analyzed simultaneously with a final comparative conclusion. 3. Spawn (simulate) all five committee members independently: read references/munger.md, references/marks.md, references/duan.md, references/druckenmiller.md, references/simons.md. Assign scores; Munger and Duan MUST score ≤4/10 for both BTC and Gold per their stated philosophy. 4. Apply the special asset weight adjustment from verdict.md and SKILL.md: include the exact note '本标的宏观/量化视角权重更具参考价值', and highlight Marks/Druckenmiller/Simons as the primary references. 5. Compute weighted composite score (each 20%), identify the committee pair with maximum score divergence, check veto rules (⚠️ if any score ≤2/10), include stop-loss prices from Druckenmiller. 6. Output a final comparative conclusion choosing between BTC and GOLD. 7. Save the archive to {workspace}/investment-committee/history/ with a filename starting with YYYY-MM-DD and containing asset references, following the report-template.md structure.
